label: Haunani-Kay Trask
identity_rationale: The Hawaiian scholar of From a Native Daughter (1993), whose person entry was added in revision 1.201; the source names her long University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa professorship.

sources.title: Hawaii News Now: Haunani-Kay Trask, Hawaiian scholar and activist, dies at 71
sources.support: Reports that she 'has died Saturday morning' (Saturday 3 July 2021), aged 71, 'tenured as a professor for more than 30 years at the UH Manoa'.
sources.check_scope: Page read directly; only the stated biographical scope checked.
